# GENERATED by gearbox <version> -- do not edit. Run `gearbox generate` to regenerate.

server:
  home_dir: ~/.cf-gears/configurable-gears/dev
permissions:
  events.consume:
  - "*"
  events.producers.manage:
  - "*"
  events.publish:
  - "*"
  events.topics.read:
  - "*"
  events.types.read:
  - "*"
gears:
  api-gateway:
    config:
      bind_addr: 127.0.0.1:8087
      public:
        exposed_only: true
  authn-resolver:
    config: {}
  authz-resolver:
    config: {}
  cluster:
    config:
      profiles:
        event-broker:
          cache:
            provider: standalone
  event-broker:
    database:
      engine: sqlite
      file: events.sqlite3
    config:
      {}
  grpc-hub:
    config:
      listen_addr: none
  static-authz-plugin:
    config: {}
  static-tr-plugin:
    config: {}
  tenant-resolver:
    config: {}
  types-registry:
    database:
      engine: sqlite
      file: types.sqlite3
    config:
      {}
